day_summary: I made a Crab Clacker from shells and a stick, and it clacks like crab talk, which I am very proud of. I told a story about the giant crab in the log and tapped the crab rhythm. I drank, picked berries and watched the sky. The pigeon stole a shell and a berry, which was annoying but funny. My belly is only half full and I did not tend my seedlings, so tonight I want to do that and pick plenty of berries. I feel sleepy, calm and happy.
